tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground (bg-base). Softly tinted toward teal, never pure white or black.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on background, card and popover. 4.5:1 and up in both themes.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces (bg-elevated): cards, the footer, sheets.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on card.

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on popover.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Aurora Teal: the ONE main action per screen, links, the logo, key numbers. Light ≈ #00696a, dark ≈ #5ac6bd.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary. Dark text in dark mode: the lighter teal needs it.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Badges, quiet highlights, the testnet banner (at 60%). Pair with primary-soft-foreground.

tokens.name: primary-soft-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on primary-soft.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and quiet fills.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on secondary.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Muted fills: skeletons, table stripes, disabled grounds.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Supporting text, captions, eyebrows on background and card.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, ghost-button hover.

tokens.name: accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on accent.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Errors and failed verdicts ONLY. Never decoration, never for money going out.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card edges, dividers, the header's bottom rule. Decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: input
tokens.usage: Form control borders.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring: solid primary, 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First chart series (the brand teal).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second chart series.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third chart series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth chart series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Fifth chart series. Not an error colour.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: The logo's exact ink for files and stills (SVG, PNG, Remotion). In the app use primary.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: One-colour logo and wordmark ink on light print and share images.

tokens.name: brand-night
tokens.usage: Night sky ground for the X banner and dark film stills.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one hero headline per page (60px at sm, 48px on phones). Light weight, tight tracking, balanced wrap.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: You're paid when your result passes review.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline, in muted-foreground.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The money is held before anyone sees the task.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Nav, buttons, table cells, footer links.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The wordmark in the header lockup (16px there), button labels, form labels.

styles.name: money
styles.usage: The amount on a task, in primary with tabular numbers. The most prominent number on any task.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Fee and fact figures, tabular numbers.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small uppercase labels above headings, in primary or muted-foreground, with a 24px rule before them.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Task IDs, hashes, rule IDs, code.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in tight chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Logo lockup gap; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap inside eyebrows (rule to label); compact stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Side gutter on phones; default card padding; header gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gaps between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header: logo to nav.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Footer column gap.

tokens.name: space-14
tokens.usage: Footer vertical padding; section spacing on phones.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Sticky site header height.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The base radius (0.625rem): buttons and small cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards, panels.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, large media.

tokens.name: radius-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon tile: 7.5 of 32 units.

logo.note: Logo construction on its 32-unit grid; see the Logo section of the brand book.

tokens.name: logo-band-height
tokens.usage: Each band's height in grid units.

tokens.name: logo-band-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the two bands, in grid units.

tokens.name: logo-piece-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the pieces inside a band, in grid units.

tokens.name: logo-body-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the bodies (tails and load) on light and dark grounds; heads are solid.

tokens.name: logo-body-opacity-tile
tokens.usage: Body opacity in white on the teal app tile.

tokens.name: logo-header-size
tokens.usage: Mark size in the site header and footer lockup.

tokens.name: logo-min-size
tokens.usage: Smallest freestanding mark.

tokens.name: logo-min-icon
tokens.usage: Smallest app icon (favicon).
